name: יְרוּשָׁא
summary: The mother of King Jotham of Judah, wife of Uzziah and daughter of Zadok (2Ki 15:33; 2Ch 27:1, where it is spelled יְרוּשָׁה). The name has the form of the qal passive participle of יָרַשׁ, feminine, “one taken in possession”; what the name meant to those who gave it (a wife taken, a child received as a possession) is not said.

evidence.note: “The name of his mother was יְרוּשָׁא, the daughter of Zadok.”
The verb whose passive the name is: to take possession, in another's place.

note: Takes j.dq.ac (2 tokens). The reading as a passive participle rests on the form; BDB's “married?” is a lead only and is not adopted.
